lines.beaver_en: They say a storm is coming. Will the event be okay?
lines.en: Even while the wind is raging, we keep preparing.

lines.beaver_en: Is the weather like this here all year round?
lines.learner: 사시사철 그렇진 않아요. 요즘 기류가 불안정해요.
lines.en: Not all year round. The air currents are unstable lately.
lines.roman: Sasisacheol geureochin anayo. Yojeum giryuga buranjeonghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: If the rain gets heavier, the stage will be dangerous, right?
lines.en: I'll secure the tents before the rain gets stronger.

lines.beaver_en: What's the weather usually like this time of year?
lines.learner: 이맘때는 아침마다 이슬이 많고 날씨가 궂어요.
lines.en: This time of year, there's lots of dew and bad weather.
lines.roman: Imamttaeneun achimmada iseuri manko nalssiga gujeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then the chairs will all be wet.
lines.learner: 네, 일찍 와서 의자를 다 닦아 둘게요.
lines.en: Yes, I'll come early and wipe all the chairs.
lines.roman: Ne, iljjik waseo uijareul da dakka dulgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Some people want to postpone the schedule.
lines.en: Guests are waiting, so it's hard to postpone.

lines.beaver_en: What if the storm comes in the afternoon?
lines.learner: 폭풍이 오기 전에 중요한 순서를 먼저 해요.
lines.en: Let's do the important parts before the storm comes.
lines.roman: Pokpungi ogi jeone jungyohan sunseoreul meonjeo haeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then when is the last performance?
lines.en: We'll start at twilight when the wind dies down.

lines.beaver_en: What if the wind starts raging again?
lines.learner: 그때는 실내로 옮길 수 있게 준비해 둘게요.
lines.en: Then I'll be ready to move it indoors.
lines.roman: Geuttaeneun sillaero omgil su itge junbihae dulgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's do our best despite the bad weather.
lines.learner: 네, 모두가 걱정하는 가운데 꼭 해낼게요.
lines.en: Yes, even while everyone worries, we'll pull it off.
lines.roman: Ne, moduga geokjeonghaneun gaunde kkok haenaelgeyo.
